title: Strings that YAML 1.1 reads as numbers
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as strings. YAML 1.1 reads them as numbers: integers with underscores, base-60 integers and floats such as `1:30`, binary integers, and hexadecimal integers with a sign. As strings they are quoted. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.
